title: Invoice screen
intro: How should the invoice screen be arranged?

options.name: Totals up top
options.cost: The amount due is always in view; the header grows taller.

options.name: Tabs under the header
options.cost: Keeps the header slim; the totals move to a tab.

options.name: Shrinks on scroll
options.cost: Full header at the top and a thin bar after; needs a scroll listener.

options.name: Table rows
options.cost: Dense and easy to scan; narrow screens need a second layout.

options.name: Cards
options.cost: Roomy and works on narrow screens; fewer items fit on screen.
